properties.displayName: UAV S44 - GCS Config/Log Tampering (Unapproved Change)
properties.description: GCS 설정/로그 변조 탐지 — config_change 이벤트가 동일 ConfigKey에 대해 같은 30분 구간 내 config_change_approval(운영자 승인 기록)과 매칭되지 않는 경우를 탐지. bin(30m) 동치 조인으로 근사 시간대별 승인 여부를 판정(부등호는 조인 조건에 사용하지 않음). MITRE: T1565
properties.query:
let alertWindow = 2h;
let binSize = 30m;
let Changes =
    UAVGcsApp_CL
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(alertWindow)
    | where EventType == "config_change"
    | extend TimeBin = bin(TimeGenerated, binSize)
    | project ChangeTime = TimeGenerated, GcsHost, Operator, ConfigKey = ComponentName, ConfigValue = PayloadDetail, TimeBin;
let Approvals =
    UAVGcsApp_CL
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(alertWindow)
    | where EventType == "config_change_approval"
    | extend TimeBin = bin(TimeGenerated, binSize)
    | project ConfigKey = ComponentName, ApprovalRef = SourceHost, TimeBin;
Changes
| join kind=leftouter (Approvals) on ConfigKey, TimeBin
| where isnull(ApprovalRef)
| extend TriggerReason = strcat("GCS_설정변조_미승인_", ConfigKey)
| extend Severity = "Medium"
| project TimeGenerated = ChangeTime, GcsHost, Operator, ConfigKey, ConfigValue, TriggerReason, Severity
| order by TimeGenerated desc

alertDetailsOverride.alertDisplayNameFormat: UAV S44 - GCS Config/Log Tampering (Unapproved Change) - {{GcsHost}}
